title: Regen authenticated_schc_dio.json DODAGIDs to upstream AddrForKey + flip line-361 binding oracle
description: Discovered-from 1p2r.4. test/vectors/authenticated_schc_dio.json DIO DODAGIDs still encode the rejected native SHA-512 profile; python/tests/test_protocol_vector_security.py:361 (test_authenticated_schc_dio_construction_has_independent_security_checks) checks root binding dio[8:24] == _addr_for_key(public_key) against it (stale-but-green per 1p2r comment: validates the rejected profile).
